---
name: proofpress
description: Close the Proofpress version-ledger loop for Markdown knowledge artifacts. Use after creating or substantially revising an ADR, design doc, PRD, README, strategy note, or similar .md file in a repository containing proofpress.py; never use for source-code files.
---
# Proofpress

Record every meaningful Markdown knowledge-artifact change with structured
testimony, deterministic verification, and decision context. Honest mismatches
are reviewer information; never rewrite claims merely to make verification pass.
## Workflow
1. If the artifact has Git history but no ledger entry, run:

```sh
   python3 proofpress.py ingest <file>
   ```
2. Preserve each surviving block's `[//]: # (ob:xxxxxxxx)` anchor while

editing. Drop the anchor when deleting its block. Do not invent anchors for
   new blocks.
3. After editing, run `python3 proofpress.py anchor <file>` and read the
`inherited`, `new`, and `gone` inventory.
4. Write a temporary claims JSON array with one honest entry per block touched
or removed:

```json
   [{"block":"a1b2c3d4","kind":"modified","note":"tightened the pitch"}]
   ```

Allowed kinds are `added`, `removed`, `modified`, `moved`, and `unchanged`.
   Do not enumerate untouched blocks. Use `unchanged` only as a deliberate
   negative claim about an important block or scope.
5. Snapshot while the decision context is still fresh:

```sh
   python3 proofpress.py snapshot <file> --kind agent --author cursor \
     --session "<session-id>" --note "<one-line changelog>" \
     --claims <claims.json> --why "<actual reason for the change>" \
     --rejected "<option — reason it was dropped>"
   ```

`--why` is required. Repeat `--rejected` for alternatives actually
   considered and dropped; omit it when none were considered.
6. Run `python3 proofpress.py verify <file>` and report its output verbatim.
Never create another snapshot just to turn a mismatch green.

Repeat the loop for every Markdown knowledge artifact touched. Snapshot no
source-code files; Git already owns that history.
